ayat.arabic: بَدِيعُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَإِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
ayat.translit: BadeeAAu alssamawati waalardi waitha qada amran fainnama yaqoolu lahu kun fayakoonu
ayat.translation: The Originator of the heavens and the earth! When He decreeth a thing, He saith unto it only: Be! and it is.
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ يُغْشِى ٱلَّيْلَ ٱلنَّهَارَ يَطْلُبُهُۥ حَثِيثًا وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ وَٱلنُّجُومَ مُسَخَّرَٰتٍۭ بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ ۗ أَلَا لَهُ ٱلْخَلْقُ وَٱلْأَمْرُ ۗ تَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
ayat.translit: Inna rabbakumu Allahu allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda fee sittati ayyamin thumma istawa AAala alAAarshi yughshee allayla alnnahara yatlubuhu hatheethan waalshshamsa waalqamara waalnnujooma musakhkharatin biamrihi ala lahu alkhalqu waalamru tabaraka Allahu rabbu alAAalameena
ayat.translation: Lo! your Lord is Allah Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days, then mounted He the Throne. He covereth the night with the day, which is in haste to follow it, and hath made the sun and the moon and the stars subservient by His command. His verily is all creation and commandment. Blessed be Allah, the Lord of the Worlds!
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.

ayat.arabic: يَوْمَ تُبَدَّلُ ٱلْأَرْضُ غَيْرَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ ۖ وَبَرَزُوا۟ لِلَّهِ ٱلْوَٰحِدِ ٱلْقَهَّارِ
ayat.translit: Yawma tubaddalu alardu ghayra alardi waalssamawatu wabarazoo lillahi alwahidi alqahhari
ayat.translation: On the day when the earth will be changed to other than the earth, and the heavens (also will be changed) and they will come forth unto Allah, the One, the Almighty,
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.

ayat.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقًا فَفَتَقْنَـٰهُمَا ۖ وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ حَىٍّ ۖ أَفَلَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayat.translit: Awalam yara allatheena kafaroo anna alssamawati waalarda kanata ratqan fafataqnahuma wajaAAalna mina almai kulla shayin hayyin afala yuminoona
ayat.translation: Have not those who disbelieve known that the heavens and the earth were of one piece, then We parted them, and we made every living thing of water? Will they not then believe?
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.

ayat.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّ فِى فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ
ayat.translit: Wahuwa allathee khalaqa allayla waalnnahara waalshshamsa waalqamara kullun fee falakin yasbahoona
ayat.translation: And He it is Who created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon. They float, each in an orbit.
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.

ayat.arabic: يَوْمَ نَطْوِى ٱلسَّمَآءَ كَطَىِّ ٱلسِّجِلِّ لِلْكُتُبِ ۚ كَمَا بَدَأْنَآ أَوَّلَ خَلْقٍ نُّعِيدُهُۥ ۚ وَعْدًا عَلَيْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا فَـٰعِلِينَ
ayat.translit: Yawma natwee alssamaa katayyi alssijlli lilkutubi kama badana awwala khalqin nuAAeeduhu waAAdan AAalayna inna kunna faAAileena
ayat.translation: The Day when We shall roll up the heavens as a recorder rolleth up a written scroll. As We began the first creation, We shall repeat it. (It is) a promise (binding) upon Us. Lo! We are to perform it.
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.

ayat.arabic: وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِٱلْعَذَابِ وَلَن يُخْلِفَ ٱللَّهُ وَعْدَهُۥ ۚ وَإِنَّ يَوْمًا عِندَ رَبِّكَ كَأَلْفِ سَنَةٍ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ
ayat.translit: WayastaAAjiloonaka bialAAathabi walan yukhlifa Allahu waAAdahu wainna yawman AAinda rabbika kaalfi sanatin mimma taAAuddoona
ayat.translation: And they will bid thee hasten on the Doom, and Allah faileth not His promise, but lo! a Day with Allah is as a thousand years of what ye reckon.
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.

ayat.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَ كُلَّ دَآبَّةٍ مِّن مَّآءٍ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِى عَلَىٰ بَطْنِهِۦ وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِى عَلَىٰ رِجْلَيْنِ وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِى عَلَىٰٓ أَرْبَعٍ ۚ يَخْلُقُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
ayat.translit: WaAllahu khalaqa kulla dabbatin min main faminhum man yamshee AAala batnihi waminhum man yamshee AAala rijlayni waminhum man yamshee AAala arbaAAin yakhluqu Allahu ma yashao inna Allaha AAala kulli shayin qadeerun
ayat.translation: Allah hath created every animal of water. Of them is (a kind) that goeth upon its belly and (a kind) that goeth upon two legs and (a kind) that goeth upon four. Allah createth what He will. Lo! Allah is Able to do all things.
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۚ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ فَسْـَٔلْ بِهِۦ خَبِيرًا
ayat.translit: Allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma fee sittati ayyamin thumma istawa AAala alAAarshi alrrahmanu faisal bihi khabeeran
ayat.translation: Who created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six Days, then He mounted the Throne. The Beneficent! Ask anyone informed concerning Him!
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.

ayat.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۖ مَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ مِن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا شَفِيعٍ ۚ أَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ
ayat.translit: Allahu allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma fee sittati ayyamin thumma istawa AAala alAAarshi ma lakum min doonihi min waliyyin wala shafeeAAin afala tatathakkaroona
ayat.translation: Allah it is Who created the heavens and the earth, and that which is between them, in six Days. Then He mounted the Throne. Ye have not, beside Him, a protecting friend or mediator. Will ye not then remember?
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.

ayat.arabic: يُدَبِّرُ ٱلْأَمْرَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يَعْرُجُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥٓ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ
ayat.translit: Yudabbiru alamra mina alssamai ila alardi thumma yaAAruju ilayhi fee yawmin kana miqdaruhu alfa sanatin mimma taAAuddoona
ayat.translation: He directeth the ordinance from the heaven unto the earth; then it ascendeth unto Him in a Day, whereof the measure is a thousand years of that ye reckon.
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلشَّمْسُ تَجْرِى لِمُسْتَقَرٍّ لَّهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ
ayat.translit: Waalshshamsu tajree limustaqarrin laha thalika taqdeeru alAAazeezi alAAaleemi
ayat.translation: And the sun runneth on unto a resting-place for him. That is the measuring of the Mighty, the Wise.
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَـٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلْعُرْجُونِ ٱلْقَدِيمِ
ayat.translit: Waalqamara qaddarnahu manazila hatta AAada kaalAAurjooni alqadeemi
ayat.translation: And for the moon We have appointed mansions till she return like an old shrivelled palm-leaf.
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.

ayat.arabic: لَا ٱلشَّمْسُ يَنۢبَغِى لَهَآ أَن تُدْرِكَ ٱلْقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيْلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ وَكُلٌّ فِى فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ
ayat.translit: La alshshamsu yanbaghee laha an tudrika alqamara wala allaylu sabiqu alnnahari wakullun fee falakin yasbahoona
ayat.translation: It is not for the sun to overtake the moon, nor doth the night outstrip the day. They float each in an orbit.
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
ayat.translit: Innama amruhu itha arada shayan an yaqoola lahu kun fayakoonu
ayat.translation: But His command, when He intendeth a thing, is only that He saith unto it: Be! and it is.
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.

ayat.arabic: خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍ وَٰحِدَةٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ ثَمَـٰنِيَةَ أَزْوَٰجٍ ۚ يَخْلُقُكُمْ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ خَلْقًا مِّنۢ بَعْدِ خَلْقٍ فِى ظُلُمَـٰتٍ ثَلَـٰثٍ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ ۖ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُصْرَفُونَ
ayat.translit: Khalaqakum min nafsin wahidatin thumma jaAAala minha zawjaha waanzala lakum mina alanAAami thamaniyata azwajin yakhluqukum fee butooni ommahatikum khalqan min baAAdi khalqin fee thulumatin thalathin thalikumu Allahu rabbukum lahu almulku la ilaha illa huwa faanna tusrafoona
ayat.translation: He created you from one being, then from that (being) He made its mate; and He hath provided for you of cattle eight kinds. He created you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, in a threefold gloom. Such is Allah, your Lord. His is the Sovereignty. There is no Allah save Him. How then are ye turned away?
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا قَدَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِۦ وَٱلْأَرْضُ جَمِيعًا قَبْضَتُهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ وَٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ مَطْوِيَّـٰتٌۢ بِيَمِينِهِۦ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
ayat.translit: Wama qadaroo Allaha haqqa qadrihi waalardu jameeAAan qabdatuhu yawma alqiyamati waalssamawatu matwiyyatun biyameenihi subhanahu wataAAala AAamma yushrikoona
ayat.translation: And they esteem not Allah as He hath the right to be esteemed, when the whole earth is His handful on the Day of Resurrection, and the heavens are rolled in His right hand. Glorified is He and High Exalted from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him).
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.

ayat.arabic: قُلْ أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَكْفُرُونَ بِٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَرْضَ فِى يَوْمَيْنِ وَتَجْعَلُونَ لَهُۥٓ أَندَادًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
ayat.translit: Qul ainnakum latakfuroona biallathee khalaqa alarda fee yawmayni watajAAaloona lahu andadan thalika rabbu alAAalameena
ayat.translation: Say (O Muhammad, unto the idolaters): Disbelieve ye verily in Him Who created the earth in two Days, and ascribe ye unto Him rivals? He (and none else) is the Lord of the Worlds.
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.

ayat.arabic: وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ مِن فَوْقِهَا وَبَـٰرَكَ فِيهَا وَقَدَّرَ فِيهَآ أَقْوَٰتَهَا فِىٓ أَرْبَعَةِ أَيَّامٍ سَوَآءً لِّلسَّآئِلِينَ
ayat.translit: WajaAAala feeha rawasiya min fawqiha wabaraka feeha waqaddara feeha aqwataha fee arbaAAati ayyamin sawaan lilssaileena
ayat.translation: He placed therein firm hills rising above it, and blessed it and measured therein its sustenance in four Days, alike for (all) who ask;
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَهِىَ دُخَانٌ فَقَالَ لَهَا وَلِلْأَرْضِ ٱئْتِيَا طَوْعًا أَوْ كَرْهًا قَالَتَآ أَتَيْنَا طَآئِعِينَ
ayat.translit: Thumma istawa ila alssamai wahiya dukhanun faqala laha walilardi itiya tawAAan aw karhan qalata atayna taiAAeena
ayat.translation: Then turned He to the heaven when it was smoke, and said unto it and unto the earth: Come both of you, willingly or loth. They said: We come, obedient.
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.

ayat.arabic: فَقَضَىٰهُنَّ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَاتٍ فِى يَوْمَيْنِ وَأَوْحَىٰ فِى كُلِّ سَمَآءٍ أَمْرَهَا ۚ وَزَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَـٰبِيحَ وَحِفْظًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ
ayat.translit: Faqadahunna sabAAa samawatin fee yawmayni waawha fee kulli samain amraha wazayyanna alssamaa alddunya bimasabeeha wahifthan thalika taqdeeru alAAazeezi alAAaleemi
ayat.translation: Then He ordained them seven heavens in two Days and inspired in each heaven its mandate; and We decked the nether heaven with lamps, and rendered it inviolable. That is the measuring of the Mighty, the Knower.
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍ
ayat.translit: Walaqad khalaqna alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma fee sittati ayyamin wama massana min lughoobin
ayat.translation: And verily We created the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in six Days, and naught of weariness touched Us.
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَـٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
ayat.translit: Waalssamaa banaynaha biaydin wainna lamoosiAAoona
ayat.translation: We have built the heaven with might, and We it is Who make the vast extent (thereof).
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.

ayat.arabic: يَـٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ
ayat.translit: Ya maAAshara aljinni waalinsi ini istataAAtum an tanfuthoo min aqtari alssamawati waalardi faonfuthoo la tanfuthoona illa bisultanin
ayat.translation: O company of jinn and men, if ye have power to penetrate (all) regions of the heavens and the earth, then penetrate (them)! Ye will never penetrate them save with (Our) sanction.
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.

ayat.arabic: لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ وَأَنزَلْنَا مَعَهُمُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ لِيَقُومَ ٱلنَّاسُ بِٱلْقِسْطِ ۖ وَأَنزَلْنَا ٱلْحَدِيدَ فِيهِ بَأْسٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَنَـٰفِعُ لِلنَّاسِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُۥ وَرُسُلَهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ
ayat.translit: Laqad arsalna rusulana bialbayyinati waanzalna maAAahumu alkitaba waalmeezana liyaqooma alnnasu bialqisti waanzalna alhadeeda feehi basun shadeedun wamanafiAAu lilnnasi waliyaAAlama Allahu man yansuruhu warusulahu bialghaybi inna Allaha qawiyyun AAazeezun
ayat.translation: We verily sent Our messengers with clear proofs, and revealed with them the Scripture and the Balance, that mankind may observe right measure; and He revealed iron, wherein is mighty power and (many) uses for mankind, and that Allah may know him who helpeth Him and His messengers, though unseen. Lo! Allah is Strong, Almighty.
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.

ayat.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ وَمِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ مِثْلَهُنَّ يَتَنَزَّلُ ٱلْأَمْرُ بَيْنَهُنَّ لِتَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدْ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عِلْمًۢا
ayat.translit: Allahu allathee khalaqa sabAAa samawatin wamina alardi mithlahunna yatanazzalu alamru baynahunna litaAAlamoo anna Allaha AAala kulli shayin qadeerun waanna Allaha qad ahata bikulli shayin AAilman
ayat.translation: Allah it is who hath created seven heavens, and of the earth the like thereof. The commandment cometh down among them slowly, that ye may know that Allah is Able to do all things, and that Allah surroundeth all things in knowledge.
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا ۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مِن تَفَـٰوُتٍ ۖ فَٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍ
ayat.translit: Allathee khalaqa sabAAa samawatin tibaqan ma tara fee khalqi alrrahmani min tafawutin fairjiAAi albasara hal tara min futoorin
ayat.translation: Who hath created seven heavens in harmony. Thou (Muhammad) canst see no fault in the Beneficent One's creation; then look again: Canst thou see any rifts?
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.

ayat.arabic: تَعْرُجُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ
ayat.translit: TaAAruju almalaikatu waalrroohu ilayhi fee yawmin kana miqdaruhu khamseena alfa sanatin
ayat.translation: (Whereby) the angels and the Spirit ascend unto Him in a Day whereof the span is fifty thousand years.
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ
ayat.translit: Waalarda baAAda thalika dahaha
ayat.translation: And after that He spread the earth,
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.

ayat.arabic: أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا
ayat.translit: Akhraja minha maaha wamarAAaha
ayat.translation: And produced therefrom the water thereof and the pasture thereof,
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا
ayat.translit: Waaljibala arsaha
ayat.translation: And He made fast the hills,
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.

ayat.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا ٱلشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ
ayat.translit: Itha alshshamsu kuwwirat
ayat.translation: When the sun is overthrown,
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ ٱنكَدَرَتْ
ayat.translit: Waitha alnnujoomu inkadarat
ayat.translation: And when the stars fall,
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.

ayat.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ
ayat.translit: Itha alssamao infatarat
ayat.translation: When the heaven is cleft asunder,
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ
ayat.translit: Waitha alkawakibu intatharat
ayat.translation: When the planets are dispersed,
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ
ayat.translit: Waalssamai thati alrrajAAi
ayat.translation: By the heaven which giveth the returning rain,
ayat.license: Arabic: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), CC BY 3.0, verbatim, source tanzil.net. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (1930), public domain; text file from Tanzil (en.pickthall). Transliteration: Tanzil en.transliteration, non-commercial use only (Tanzil translation terms); HTML markup removed.
